name: Threads of Eternity marks a target from Discordance damage (#3611)
contract: Threads of Eternity 806209 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Thread of Eternity 572127, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Discordance (100% chance), a single Discordance hit should mark the target with 572127.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Thread of Eternity mark before any cast
Discordance's hit marks the target with Thread of Eternity
